rules.rule: Display title, source, byline, date, update status, content type, subscription terms, sponsored label, correction status, and reading progress beside every read, subscribe, save, share, or publish action.
rules.rationale: Decision context must be visible at the moment of commitment.
rules.failureMode: Missing context causes sponsored content indistinguishable from editorial content.

rules.rule: Show sponsored label in the same visual group as the primary action.
rules.rationale: The highest-risk identifier must travel with the action.
rules.failureMode: The user acts without seeing sponsored label.

rules.rule: Label data freshness or status whenever the view contains reader pages, feeds, archives, editorial dashboards, and media cards.
rules.rationale: Users must know whether operational data is current.
rules.failureMode: The interface hides stale context around reader pages, feeds, archives, editorial dashboards, and media cards.

rules.rule: Require a review step before subscription submit, publish action, correction update, comment moderation, and media autoplay.
rules.rationale: High-cost actions need an interruption for verification.
rules.failureMode: The user completes subscription submit, publish action, correction update, comment moderation, and media autoplay without review.

rules.rule: Block silent changes to critical values after review in read, subscribe, save, share, or publish action.
rules.rationale: Consent depends on the reviewed values staying stable.
rules.failureMode: The UI allows sponsored content indistinguishable from editorial content.

rules.rule: Provide a recovery or correction path when sponsored content indistinguishable from editorial content.
rules.rationale: High-cost mistakes need visible next steps.
rules.failureMode: The user cannot recover after sponsored content indistinguishable from editorial content.

rules.rule: Match density to reader pages, feeds, archives, editorial dashboards, and media cards; do not use decorative spacing that separates labels from values.
rules.rationale: Domain work depends on scanning related facts together.
rules.failureMode: Related labels and values drift apart visually.

rules.rule: Keep required identifiers visible at mobile widths for read, subscribe, save, share, or publish action.
rules.rationale: Narrow screens are common at decision time.

rules.rule: Do not use decorative motion around reading text, scroll effects, media controls, paywall panels, or feed transitions.
rules.rationale: Motion must not hide or trivialize domain state.
rules.failureMode: Motion obscures sponsored content indistinguishable from editorial content.

rules.rule: Provide a reduced-motion path for status changes involving updated-corrected, paywall-limit, offline-saved, transcript-unavailable, ad-blocked-gap, end-of-article, comment-moderation, and source-unavailable.
rules.rationale: State meaning must survive user motion preferences.

rules.rule: Use exact labels for updated, corrected, sponsored, opinion, analysis, breaking, paywall meter, source, byline, and transcript.
rules.rationale: Precise terms map to different user decisions.
rules.failureMode: A vague label masks sponsored content indistinguishable from editorial content.

rules.rule: Do not use color alone to distinguish updated-corrected, paywall-limit, offline-saved, transcript-unavailable, ad-blocked-gap, end-of-article, comment-moderation, and source-unavailable.
rules.rationale: Status must be perceivable without color vision.
rules.failureMode: Users miss a state among updated-corrected, paywall-limit, offline-saved, transcript-unavailable, ad-blocked-gap, end-of-article, comment-moderation, and source-unavailable.

rules.rule: Provide states for updated-corrected, paywall-limit, offline-saved, transcript-unavailable, ad-blocked-gap, end-of-article, comment-moderation, and source-unavailable.
rules.rationale: Domain flows contain more than loading/success/error.
rules.failureMode: A missing state causes sponsored content indistinguishable from editorial content.

rules.rule: Use exact labels for updated, corrected, sponsored, opinion, analysis, breaking, paywall meter, source, byline, and transcript.
rules.failureMode: A generic label causes sponsored content indistinguishable from editorial content.

rules.rule: Define ambiguous values as updated, corrected, sponsored, opinion, analysis, breaking, paywall limit reached, and saved offline.
rules.rationale: Users should not infer whether values are final or provisional.
rules.failureMode: A provisional value is treated as final in read, subscribe, save, share, or publish action.

rules.rule: Provide states for updated-corrected, paywall-limit, offline-saved, transcript-unavailable, ad-blocked-gap, end-of-article, comment-moderation, and source-unavailable.
rules.rationale: Domain flows contain more than loading/success/error.
rules.failureMode: A missing state causes sponsored content indistinguishable from editorial content.

rules.rule: Preserve user input or task context when recovery is needed after read, subscribe, save, share, or publish action.
rules.rationale: Recovery without preserved context still fails the task.
rules.failureMode: The user must restart after sponsored content indistinguishable from editorial content.

rules.rule: Expose an empty or unavailable state that explains whether reader pages, feeds, archives, editorial dashboards, and media cards are absent, filtered, stale, or permission denied.
rules.rationale: Empty states need cause and next action.
rules.failureMode: Users cannot distinguish absent data from hidden data.

rules.rule: Keep sponsored label visible in confirmation and receipt states.
rules.rationale: Receipts are evidence and recovery anchors.
